name: WARRIORS OF CHAOS: LORD ON CHAOS DRAGON
description: A Chaos Dragon is a nemesis of order and sanity, a horror of ancient age and power that can break the backs of armies with its steel claws and teeth. Their twin maws breathe death upon their foes; one exhaling dark flame, as the other emits corrosive gas. Only the most powerful Lords of Chaos can ride such a monster, and even then it is more an unholy alliance of destruction than a matter of master and servant.A Twin-headed Terror From the SkiesThis multipart plastic kit builds 1 Lord on Chaos Dragon and 1 Chaos Sorcerer on foot for your Warriors of Chaos armies in games of Warhammer: The Old World. This powerful unit will wreak havoc on the battlefield, combining speed with an impressive capacity for destruction that's only enhanced by the rider. This large and imposing miniature, measuring 305mm from wingtip to wingtip and 280mm tall, will be the pride of your collection, looking just as impressive on your shelves as it does leading a mighty army.Customise Your KitThe Chaos Dragon's rider can be assembled as either a Chaos Lord or a Sorcerer Lord, with the other on foot. The Chaos Lord is clad in heavy plate armour, and equipped with a tall shield or axe in one hand, and a long polearm or sword in the other. They have 2 horned helmets to choose from. The Sorcerer Lord comes with 3 head options. The Chaos Dragon has 2 different styles of heads, 2 sets of interchangeable horns to customise their look, and 2 sets of saddles and accessories to choose from.Contents:– 101 plastic components– 1 Citadel 100mm by 150mm Rectangle Base– 1 Citadel 30mm by 30mm Square Base– 1 construction guideThese miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue– Warhammer Colour paints
